headcountShare.label: Share of headcount
headcountShare.definition: Percentage of the firm's 46,500 headcount based in each region, as stated in the 10-K.

source.label: FY2024 Form 10-K, Item 1 Human Capital Management
source.quote: As of December 2024, we had headcount of 46,500, offices in over 40 countries, and 50% of our headcount was based in the Americas, 20% in Europe, Middle East and Africa (EMEA) and 30% in Asia.

sites.name: India offices
sites.description: Offices with approximately 1.9 million square feet in India.

source.label: FY2024 Form 10-K, Item 2 Properties
source.quote: In India, we have offices with approximately 1.9 million square feet, the majority of which have leases that will expire starting in 2028.

notes: The FY2024 10-K gives headcount shares by region (Americas 50%, EMEA 20%, Asia 30% of 46,500) and office floor space by region in Item 2: Americas about 6.3 million sq ft, EMEA about 1.8 million, Asia/Australia/New Zealand about 2.9 million, of which India about 1.9 million. Floor space is not recorded as a metric because the lens has no square-feet unit; it is quoted in the sites. No employee counts by country or state, and no state-level office data, are published in the 10-K. The 10-K's 'Asia' headcount region and 'Asia, Australia and New Zealand' property region are named differently and are not merged. Bank branch and deposit data (FDIC) for Goldman Sachs Bank USA were not researched.
